keyterms.description: The stream's keyterms for this session, in the order the provider should get them: at most 100, each 1 to 50 characters after trimming, no control characters (duplicates are removed case-insensitively). An empty array is none. Once a session has an answer, it replaces the stream's captions.keyterms for that session; an answer that breaks a rule is ignored whole and the last list stays in force.
